summary.intent: Execute Phase 59 (FUSE IPNS Verify/Publish Hardening and Cleanup) — 4 sequential plans addressing IPNS error propagation, enum migration, dead-code removal, and sequence unification — using the GSD wave-execution workflow. Mid-execution, the user also asked for a staging DB investigation into a quota discrepancy.
summary.outcome: Waves 1–3 (plans 59-01, 59-02, 59-03) completed and verified with 96 tests passing and zero new clippy warnings in the fuse crate. Wave 4 (59-04) was still running at transcript end. The staging DB query confirmed 23/43 folder_ipns records are unsigned legacy records (53%), directly validating the VerifyError::Legacy hardening. The quota investigation was initiated but not resolved.

repo: Root `npm test` runs `pnpm --parallel -r run test` — full monorepo parallel, RAM-starving; scope Rust-only phases to `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` instead
CI does not run clippy — only `cargo test`, winfsp CI, and E2E are enforced gates; clippy clean is advisory not blocking

Pre-existing `vec-init-then-push` and `type_complexity` clippy warnings in `cipherbox-crypto` cause `cargo clippy -D warnings` to fail at the dependency level before fuse lints are reported; use `--no-deps` to isolate fuse

53% of staging `folder_ipns` rows are unsigned legacy records (signed_record IS NULL); signing convention landed 2026-04-04 (#448) — rows predating that are never auto-upgraded unless re-published or TEE re-signs (every 6h on enrolled names)
Two 'partial-fields' rows exist on staging: signed_record present but public_key NULL — verify.rs treats these as a potential downgrade vector (fail-closed), distinct from true legacy
FUSE embedded sequence 0 on first publish while TS SDK embedded 1 and API assumed 0+1=1 — this skew required a tolerance in verify.rs that plan 59-04 removes
Worktree isolation adds unnecessary overhead for strictly sequential single-plan-per-wave phases; it only pays off when plans execute concurrently
Staging Postgres: container `cipherbox-staging-postgres-1`, user `cipherbox`, db `cipherbox_staging`; accessible via SSH to `76.13.151.200`

code.finding: Finding A: build_folder_metadata was swallowing a wrap_key error and publishing a FilePointer with ipns_private_key_encrypted: None, making the file unrecoverable
Finding B: no re-resolution occurred when file_meta_ipns_name changed under an unchanged mtime, leaving stale CID/keys cached
Transient compile errors at this line during Wave 2's atomic VerifyError::Legacy enum migration — expected while all 9 match arms propagate across 6 files
One of two write sites for the now-removed VerifiedResolve::signature_verified field (Wave 3, Finding E.1)
Vector generator had public_key/private_key in its interface and all 8 push sites; removed in Wave 3 along with unused bytesToHex helper; tests/vectors/ipns/verify.json regenerated
Pre-existing clippy Default-impl warning at line 75 — not introduced by phase 59; confirm pre-existing before flagging in review

workflow: GSD #2070: executor writes SUMMARY.md inside a worktree but worktree is force-removed before committing it — summary is lost permanently; mitigation is to commit SUMMARY before triggering cleanup-wave

When worktrees genuinely need node_modules (parallel concurrent agents), subagents must run `pnpm i` to initialize their own copy — never symlink back to parent checkout; symlinks cause cleanup-wave to fail closed on untracked files
cleanup-wave helper fails closed on any untracked files in the worktree (including node_modules symlinks) — pre-merge cleanup of untracked files is required
cleanup-wave prints 'commit_failed' as a false-negative even when the commit lands — do not retry on this message alone; verify with git log
Sequential phases (one plan per wave, strict dependency chain) should skip worktree isolation entirely; worktrees only add value when multiple plans execute concurrently

Staging DB legacy-record queries: `SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE signed_record IS NULL) AS legacy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE signed_record IS NOT NULL) AS signed FROM folder_ipns WHERE latest_cid IS NOT NULL` is the authoritative check for unsigned IPNS records

Worktrees were used despite the phase being strictly sequential (one plan per wave) — this was unnecessary and caused the node_modules symlink problem and the SUMMARY.md commit risk
